home.title: Orqevio · Tasks, docs and a vault, in a copy that’s only yours
home.description: Orqevio brings together tasks, documentation and an end-to-end encrypted vault in a copy that lives in your Cloudflare account or on your server. Your AI agents work in it through MCP, with the permissions you choose.
home.share: Tasks, documents and an encrypted vault in a copy that’s only yours, open to your AI agents through MCP.

install.title: Install Orqevio · Your copy on Cloudflare or with Docker
install.description: Install your copy of Orqevio with one command in your Cloudflare account, with the “Deploy to Cloudflare” button or with Docker on your server. Step-by-step guide, first sign-in and updates.

privacy.title: Privacy · Orqevio
privacy.description: orqevio.com keeps nobody’s data: no cookies, no analytics and no forms. Each copy of Orqevio belongs to its owner and lives in their Cloudflare account or on their server.

404.title: Page not found · Orqevio
404.description: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist on orqevio.com. Go back home or to the Orqevio install guide.
